definitions.explanation: Describes a liquid, gas, or substance that is low in concentration or density. The physical sense of being diluted or thinned out.
Describes abstract things like awareness, interest, or connections that are weak, faint, or lacking in strength. The figurative sense of something being insubstantial.

examples.japanese: ⟦{高地|こうち}→高地：29340_kouchi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}だ。
examples.english: The air is thin at high altitude.

examples.japanese: ⟦{酸素|さんそ}→酸素：02830_sanso⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}な⟦{環境|かんきょう}→環境：00174_kankyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦|くる}しく→苦しい：02636_kurushii⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: In an oxygen-poor environment, it becomes hard to breathe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{標高|ひょうこう}→標高：13175_hyoukou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がる→上がる：00615_agaru⟧⟦につれて→につれて：28400_nitsurete⟧⟦{大気|たいき}→大気：03388_taiki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ますます→ますます：01604_masumasu⟧{希薄|きはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The atmosphere becomes increasingly thin as altitude rises.

examples.japanese: ⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}だ。
examples.english: There is a weak sense of crisis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{都会|とかい}→都会：02475_tokai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{近所|きんじょ}→近所：01318_kinjo⟧{付|づ}き{合|あ}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧がちだ。
examples.english: In cities, neighborly relations tend to become tenuous.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{間|あいだ}→間：00914_aida⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}になっていること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{問題視|もんだいし}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: It is seen as a problem that interest in politics has been waning among young people.

notes:
USAGE:
Also written as {稀薄|きはく} with the character {稀|き}. Used as a na-adjective: {希薄|きはく}な～, {希薄|きはく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧. The figurative sense (sense 2) is more common in everyday usage. Typical abstract nouns it modifies include ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧ (awareness), ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧ (interest), ⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧ (relationship), and ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧ (basis).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}: awareness is weak
- ⟦{関心|かんしん}→関心：00182_kanshin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}: interest is thin
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}: air is thin
- ⟦{根拠|こんきょ}→根拠：10147_konkyo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{希薄|きはく}: basis is tenuous
